headline: 愛丁堡與倫敦藝文評論
context: 愛丁堡影展推出偽紀錄片恐怖片《Snapshot》，講述一支女性通靈調查小組追緝開膛手傑克的故事；愛丁堡藝穗節的音樂劇場《The Singer》，描寫聽障者喬（Joe）用觸覺帶領街頭藝人重新感受音樂；倫敦O2體育館則有亞莉安娜·格蘭德（Ariana Grande）「永恆陽光」（Eternal Sunshine）巡演的最後幾場演出，評論對她的身心狀況表達關切。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Edinburgh film festival A women’s spiritualist investigation team go after the serial killer, braving evil forces conjured into being by fear, misogyny and political rage Here is a cheerfully ingenious lo-fi movie experiment from first-time feature director Joseph Archer and writer-performer Cathy Wippel; it’s a found-footage horror with hints of Blair Witch and Peeping Tom, set in the Victorian London of Jack the Ripper. The footage that’s been found, incidentally, is composed of unearthed reels of monochrome film from the 1880s, which we see entirely in a kinetoscope-style circular screen, flickering and glitching and buzzing with eerie accidental jump cuts from one weird scene to the next. It was supposedly shot by an enterprising pioneer called Tamworth (we hear his voice from behind the camera, but never see his face), who, it becomes clear, is a sensational and until now unacknowledged genius of early cinema – in that he manages to record lip-sync sound on to wax cylinders so we can actually hear what everyone is saying. With a cheeky touch of implied black comedy, the film is suggesting that Tamworth was somehow able to carry his camera and recording equipment to these places of Victorian horror and underclass shame as easily as an iPhone. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Traverse theatre, Edinburgh In Cora Bissett’s highly enjoyable and accessible show, a deaf man reintroduces a busker to the joy of music ‘There are other ways to listen,” says Joe (Jamie Rea) to his new friend Andy (Dylan Wood), a busker he has discovered on the street and invited home for a drink. He takes off his shoes, the better to feel the vibrations through the floor, and straps on a gadget called a Subpac . He gets Andy to lean his full height against a towering speaker stack. Only then does the rumbling bass kick in. Little, perhaps, to distinguish them from two drum’n’bass enthusiasts, but this is something else. Joe is less singer than signer, a BSL speaker whose disability has been no impediment to his love of music. He tells an incredulous Andy that he appreciates sound by feeling it and puts his hand on the musician’s acoustic guitar to demonstrate. They form the least likely of songwriting partnerships. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The O2, London On her last live dates before she steps back from the public eye, Grande holds her own – but it’s also impossible to avoid feeling concerned for her wellbeing There’s a thrum of excitement in the air as an eight-minute countdown starts and Ariana Grande’s unmistakable silhouette appears on a giant backlit curtain on the stage of the O2. Is it actually her? Posing there for eight minutes before the show starts? It can’t be. But is it? It’s the first time we question what is and isn’t real at this Eternal Sunshine tour stop, a 10-night residency and a robust arena show that ultimately wants us to see one thing and experience another. Collectively, we’ve been scolded for talking about it – the “endless, ongoing public scrutiny” of Ariana Grande’s body has pushed her to “[take] a step back from visibility” when this tour ends. It can’t be nice or fun to have your body examined and discussed for any reason but it is impossible to witness the 33-year-old’s frame on stage and not be gripped by genuine concern for her. Two songs in, a lump forms in my throat, which is not the intended effect of Positions, the zippy title track of her 2020 album. As the set around her is engulfed in digital flames, Grande sings about her infinite flexibility vis a vis relationship boundaries and sexual olympics and all I can think is: she looks like a little kid. thread_text:
愛丁堡影展推出偽紀錄片恐怖片《Snapshot》，由喬瑟夫·亞契（Joseph Archer）執導、凱西·維波（Cathy Wippel）編劇兼主演，講述一支女性通靈調查小組，在1880年代倫敦追緝開膛手傑克的故事；片中畫面偽裝成當年一位攝影先驅拍下的膠捲，還做出對嘴的蠟筒錄音效果。

愛丁堡藝穗節的音樂劇場《The Singer》，講的是聽障者喬（Joe，由傑米·雷 Jamie Rea 飾演），透過觸覺震動，帶領一名街頭藝人（安迪，由狄倫·伍德 Dylan Wood 飾演）重新感受音樂，兩人因此組成了創作搭檔。

倫敦O2體育館則有亞莉安娜·格蘭德（Ariana Grande）「永恆陽光」（Eternal Sunshine）巡演的最後幾場演出——這是她在公開表示要暫別大眾視野前的最後幾場現場——評論在盛大的舞台效果之餘，也對她近來受到的外界關注與身心狀況表達關切。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 16 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 這幾天的藝文評論，橫跨愛丁堡跟倫敦。先說電影，愛丁堡影展有一部偽紀錄片恐怖片《Snapshot》，講一支女性通靈調查小組，在1880年代的倫敦追緝開膛手傑克，畫面刻意做成當年膠捲的樣子，還配上對嘴的老式錄音效果。劇場這邊，愛丁堡藝穗節的音樂劇場《The Singer》，講的是一位聽障者，用觸覺帶著一名街頭藝人重新感受音樂，兩人因此變成了創作搭檔。演唱會的部分，亞莉安娜·格蘭德在倫敦O2體育館，唱完了「永恆陽光」巡演最後幾場——她公開說完這輪巡演後，要暫別大眾視野。評論在稱讚舞台效果之餘，也對她最近的身心狀況表達關切。
